benchmarks.name: Simply Supported Beam / Strip Navier Limit
benchmarks.formulation: 1D Euler-Bernoulli beam under uniform load: w_max = 5*q*L^4 / (384*E*I)

benchmarks.name: Cantilever Beam Tip Load
benchmarks.formulation: 1D Cantilever beam under concentrated tip load P: w_tip = P*L^3 / (3*E*I), sigma_root = P*L*h / (2*I)

benchmarks.name: Simply Supported Rectangular Plate under Uniform Load
benchmarks.formulation: 2D Kirchhoff plate Navier double-sine series solution: w_max = alpha * q * a^4 / D

benchmarks.name: Clamped Rectangular Plate under Uniform Load
benchmarks.formulation: 2D Kirchhoff plate Timoshenko / Roark clamped solution: w_max = beta * q * a^4 / D

benchmarks.name: Point Load on Plate (Concentrated Component Weight)
benchmarks.formulation: Localized central point load P: w_center = alpha_p * P * a^2 / D

benchmarks.name: Four Corner Standoff Supported Board
benchmarks.formulation: PCB supported at 4 discrete corner standoffs with free edges under uniform load

benchmarks.name: Static Equilibrium & Transverse Reaction Force Balance
benchmarks.formulation: |sum(R_z) - F_total| / F_total < 1e-4 across all support types

benchmarks.name: Mesh Refinement & Spatial Convergence
benchmarks.formulation: Monotonic reduction in relative error as grid is refined from 11x11 to 21x21 to 41x41

benchmarks.name: Adversarial Inputs and Boundary Condition Diagnostics
benchmarks.formulation: Fail-closed rejection of unconstrained plates (0 supports), negative thickness, zero modulus, and non-physical dimensions
